records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The additional week resulted in higher net revenue, gross margin dollars, research and development expense, and selling general and administrative expense for the fiscal quarter ended February 4, 2024, compared to the corresponding prior year fiscal period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net revenue from our semiconductor solutions segment increased in the fiscal quarter ended February 4, 2024 compared to the prior year fiscal period due to strong product demand for networking products, partially offset by lower demand for our server storage and broadband products.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net revenue from our infrastructure software segment increased in the fiscal quarter ended February 4, 2024 compared to the prior year fiscal period primarily due to contributions from VMware.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin was $7,375 million for the fiscal quarter ended February 4, 2024 compared to $6,004 million for the fiscal quarter ended January 29, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income from our semiconductor solutions segment was relatively flat for the quarter ended February 4, 2024 compared to the prior year fiscal period.
